verdict.rationale: Kick supports background automation via Rules that 'run automatically every time a matching transaction syncs' and AI categorization that runs automatically on ~97% of transactions without manual triggering. Docs also mention MCP/CLI use to 'automate month-end checks' and build cross-workspace workflows, suggesting AI-driven automation beyond simple rules. However, missing for 10: no evidence of a scheduling/cron mechanism for autonomous agent runs, no proof that MCP-based 'automations' execute unattended in the background versus requiring an active AI session, and no independent corroboration of autonomous operation.
